name: Amano Chiwa
source: Chiwa is Sana's best friend who has an odd personality.She always speaks with a silent tone and will often point the obvious during times relating to something perverted that either Takumi or Osamu have done. She will usually do certain things that give her a creepy visage and is known to be unpredictable
